from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted key facts from one judicial document to enable matching."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="Internal identifier for the document (e.g. '《判决文书1》')")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="The court issuing the ruling")
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The specific case number associated with the document")
    procedural_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of proceeding (e.g., '二审刑事', '民事执行复议', '行政再审')")
    party_names: list[str] = Field(description="Names of parties mentioned as appellants, defendants, or applicants")
    execution_amounts: list[str] = Field(description="Monetary amounts mentioned (e.g. '1217369.31 元', '100 元')")
    outcome_keywords: list[str] = Field(description="Key disposition phrases (e.g. '维持原判', '准许撤回上诉', '驳回再审申请')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim text supporting the classification or matching")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
